Default and temporary sort are now separate. Reload **http://maker:4001/app.html**:

> 1. Press the **⚙** button beside the sort dropdown. In **Settings**, set **Default sort** to, say, **Title A–Z**, and press **Save**. The list reorders and a line under the sort box confirms "Sorted by your default (Title A–Z)."
> 2. Now use the **Sort dropdown** to switch to **Newest first** — notice the line changes to "Temporary sort — return to default (Title A–Z)," and a **reload** of the page brings back your **default** (Title A–Z), not the temporary choice.
> 3. Use the **"return to default"** link to snap back without reloading.

Does this match what you meant — a default you set deliberately in Settings, with the dropdown as a throwaway override that never becomes the new default?
